literal_original_statement: Assume full AC. Let $K:S^1\to S^3$ be a smooth oriented knot with a chosen compact exterior $E_K$. There exists a finite inclusion-minimal collection $\mathcal T$ of pairwise disjoint incompressible tori in the interior of $E_K$ such that every component of $E_K$ cut along $\mathcal T$ is atoroidal or Seifert-fibered. Any two such inclusion-minimal collections are ambient isotopic in $E_K$. Atoroidal pieces in this statement are not asserted to be hyperbolic.
ambiguity: Original and current Statement say smooth knot/exterior, but incompressible tori and ANY two collections are unqualified; actual Definition only specifies a smooth ambient manifold and an unspecified product neighborhood. No global smooth-surface convention has been supplied. Current Proof2.1,3.1,7.1 use smooth hypotheses not entailed for such broad TOP inputs.

exact_regularization_obstruction.proved_invariant: A smooth ambient diffeomorphism maps a smooth embedded torus to a smooth embedded torus. In a smooth ball meeting a smooth torus in z=0, a compactly supported TOP ambient vertical shear z↦z+εχ(x,y)η(z)|x|, for Lipschitzη and sufficiently smallε, is strictly increasing in z and has continuous inverse; its image torus has the graph ε|x| near0 and is not C1. The scalar time multiple gives a TOP ambient isotopy. Smoothness therefore cannot follow from a TOP ambient isotopy.
exact_regularization_obstruction.conditional_JSJ_application: Given a nonempty smooth minimal JSJ system, perform this shear in a ball on one torus disjoint from all other tori and boundary. TOP disk obstructions, two-sidedness, TOP product parallelisms, piece homeomorphism types and finite minimality are transported by the actual homeomorphism. No smooth ambient diffeomorphism carries the original smooth union to this nonsmooth union.
exact_regularization_obstruction.honest_counterexample_status: This record does NOT claim a fully independently audited concrete knot counterexample: nonempty knot-system existence and the precise TOP-versus-smooth Seifert predicate still require a correctly typed instantiated supplier. Current ex17 prefix is a concrete cable candidate, but no missing generic capture/triangulation theorem is inferred. The regularity invariant alone already blocks the current smooth uniqueness proof on arbitrary TOP inputs.
